title: The Security Program at a Glance
description: Interactive four-layer SVG diagram of an organizational security program: Board & CEO, CISO & Security Leadership, the four Security Functions, and the Foundations. Hover any layer for its role; arrows show metrics flowing up and strategy flowing down.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: Organizational security program structure and governance
learningObjectives: Identify the four layers of an organizational security program and who owns each.
Explain how metrics flow up to the board and strategy and policy flow down to the foundations.
Reason about why every layer depends on the foundations below it operating honestly.
educational.prerequisites: Basic awareness that organizations have executives, security teams, and supporting processes.

pedagogical.modelType: static layered diagram with hover reveals
controls: Hover/tap the CISO & Security Leadership layer
Hover/tap each of the four Security Functions
Hover/tap the metrics-up and strategy-down arrows
pedagogical.assessment: Students place a given activity (e.g., 'maintain the risk register', 'run the SOC') in the correct layer and explain whether it flows up or down.
misconceptionsAddressed: Believing a security program is a checklist rather than an interdependent system.
Assuming the board does security work rather than setting appetite and receiving metrics.
